newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH FINMIN PULLS LICENCES OF 13 UNTRADED FUNDS.
newsitem.headline: CZECH FINMIN PULLS LICENCES OF 13 UNTRADED FUNDS.

text.p: The Czech Finance Ministry withdrew licences from 13 investment funds which never issued shares, the local news agency CTK said on Tuesday.

CTK quoted ministry spokeswoman Ludmila Nutilova as saying that the funds, established for Czech individual investors during the vouchers-for-shares privatisation programme from 1992-1995, violated the law on collective investment.
Finance Ministry officials were not available for comment.
CTK said the ministry would ask a court to eliminate the funds from the business registry.

The 13 funds, as listed by the agency, are: 1. Jihozapadni Investicni Fond (IF), Cento IF, Ceskomoravsky IF, Invest Progres IF, IF Burzovni, IF Euroinvest, IF Finas, IF Komercni, J.B. IF, Karlovarsky IF, Motofond IF, Proregio IF, and Sdruzeny IF.
